name: ecoquiz
description: ECOQUIZ - quizzes personalizados e banco educacional dos 17 ODS.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/shared build && concurrently -n server,web -c "#2F8054,#2563EB" "pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/server dev" "pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/shared build && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/server build && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/web typecheck
